title: Searchable Project
tagline: A Dapp to make it easy to Search for related projects and create SBT token with proof of ownership
description:
**Challenges in Generating Innovative Ideas:**
- Absence of related projects for inspiration
- Lack of supporting evidence for intellectual property
- Problem of idea duplication

**Building a Project Platform:**
- Storing project data from hackathon platforms
- Searching for related projects by name, categories, or technologies
- Utilizing SBT tokens for proof of ownership or intellectual property
how_its_made:
I developed the dApp using React and styled it with Chakra UI. The contract was built using Hardhat. I deployed my contracts on the Filecoin Testnet and Scroll Testnet. 

**I used the following technologies:**
- Filecoin - I deployed the contract on Filecoin Testnet
- Tableland - Store project data in Tableland
- Scroll - I deployed the contract on Scroll Testnet
